name: PyDPF maze gradient-discount pilot v1
scope: Separate exploratory supervised-localization experiment; not Dacca, MLE, IFAD, or a complete paper replication
objective: Original position squared error plus sine/cosine orientation error plus autoencoder reconstruction error
optimizer: Original AdamW: encoder/state-encoder/decoder LR .005, flow LR .001, weight decay .01, betas .8/.99, eps 1e-9; ExponentialLR .99 each epoch
normalization: Original global image mean/std retained, computed once on CPU and shared; includes held-out images as in the author script. Labels from held-out trajectories are never used for training or tuning.
checkpoint_selection: Lowest validation final-time position MSE within five epochs, as in the original training loop; test data never select alpha or checkpoint
test_evaluation: Same frozen ordinary ParticleFilter and three new paired particle seeds, J100, entire held-out 700 trajectories; save predictions/truth and squared errors
determinism_scope: PyDPF deterministic mode, PyTorch strict deterministic algorithms and CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG=:4096:8; no guarantee across hardware/software versions
gradient_discount_scope: Existing public StopGradientDPF(alpha=.97) discounts inherited log-weight derivatives; it does not detach all state-path derivatives. Native DPF is a separate baseline. Alpha0 equivalence is checked, not assumed.
correctness: Real-data T99/J100/B2 controls for two model seeds, same parameters and random stream. Require finite outputs/gradients, exact forward equality between native_stop and public1 and between public1 and discount097/public0. Gradient equality alpha1 is recorded with repeat-control context, not mathematically certified.
cost_guard: Before training, one unchanged-state T99/J100/B64 forward/backward per training arm, plus ordinary-filter evaluation timing. Require 1.5 times projected six five-epoch runs plus evaluation + 240 seconds reserve within remaining allocation. Stop otherwise; no smaller replacement experiment or automatic retry.
failure_policy: Preserve exception/nonfinite proposal, last valid model/optimizer, raw records and allocation cost. No automatic rerun. Do not count failed fits as fast successful fits.
comparison_limit: Two training seeds and five epochs are a feasibility pilot only. No claim of general superiority, paper-level performance, improved likelihood, or PyPOMP software speed. No hyperparameter search.
